title: Assorted Wall Accessorie Swing Arm Double Towel Rail 12.5-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade bathroom organization with a wall mount swing arm double towel rail that keeps towels within reach and folds close to the wall when not in use.

  • Two pivoting arms: swivel independently for flexible towel placement and easy access
  • Space-saving wall mount: helps keep towels off countertops and frees up bathroom space
  • Solid brass construction: crafted for enduring everyday use
  • Concealed screw mounting: clean look with included installation hardware
  • Coordinated design: made to pair with other pieces in the Waverly Place collection

Specifications

  • Category: Assorted Wall Accessories
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Material: Brass
  • Overall dimensions: 12.5 in L x 7 in W x 7.1 in H
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included items: Towel rail and all installation hardware
  • Finish options: multiple designer finish options available
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Waverly Place Collection 2 Swing Arm Towel Rail
_previous.description: Designed with multi-use and modernity in mind, this space saving double arm towel bar is an ideal addition for your bathroom and/or kitchen. Each arm swivels independently and snuggles close to the wall when not in use - excellent to keep your bathroom and/or kitchen organized!
